reasoning_content: I need to check MainPage.vue to see if it's using AppLayout and what's in its template section.

action.command: cd /workspace && sed -n '1,12p' resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue | grep -n "AppLayout" ; grep -n "AppLayout\|<template>" resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue | head -3; echo ===; sed -n "$(grep -n '<template>' resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue | head -1 | cut -d: -f1),+6p" resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue; echo ===; cat resources/js/layouts/AppLayout.vue
